Name: Nexus Mods Button
Author: Pickysaurus
Description:
This mod adds a button to the main menu which will open the Nexus Mods website to the Stardew Valley homepage when clicked. This is intended as a little QoL shortcut. The position of the button is chosen so that it doesn't conflict with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2536?]ModUpdateMenu[/url]. 


[size=4]Install[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install with Vortex or extract to your mods folder. 
[*]Run the game via SMAPI. 
[/list]
